name: Sonam Wangchuk
bio:
Head of 400kV Substation at Bhutan Power Corporation · Being an average performing student during my pre-primary and middle secondary schools, I did not have specific ambitions until I entered into high school. My interest in pursuing engineering started when I realized that I have keen interest in mathematics. Finally, I earned a government scholarship at College of Science and Technology (CST), Royal University of Bhutan (RUB), the only technical college in the country then. 
After completing my undergraduate course in July, 2013, I currently work as the Head of 400kV Jigmeling Substation under Bhutan Power Corporation limited.
